id: title:georgemunyoro:add a statistics provider for the cost planner

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a fallback mechanism for HogQL cost estimation, allowing the query planner to proceed when ClickHouse rollup data is unavailable, missing, or failing, rather than blocking the user's request.
review.reason: Adds a new module, posthog/hogql/cost/statistics.py, defining an EventVolume dataclass and two providers (ClickHouseStatisticsProvider, FixedStatisticsProvider) to fetch and cache event-volume statistics for HogQL cost planning.
